confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and the supplied Phuket, Chiang Mai and Vientiane figures; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are better calibrated than accommodation, where Koh Samui's resort-heavy stock varies widely. Cocktail and wine derive from the beer anchor via a typical tourist-venue multiplier because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from one search summary citing the RBA rates page; I did not open the page to confirm the table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored mainly to Phuket, the closest Thai island-tourism comparable, with Chiang Mai and Vientiane as lower-cost bounds. Most anchors sit close to Phuket; restaurant meals are set a little lower and basic-hotel rooms a little higher, by judgment rather than observed Samui data.
